correctness.rationale: For every k>=5 the even restriction of f(x)=x+x^3 mod 2^k is an isometry since f(a)-f(b)=(a-b)(1+a^2+ab+b^2), multiplier=1 mod4 for evens; it therefore permutes the finite even set. For x with ν2(x)=r>=1, f(x)-x=x^3 has valuation 3r. The iterate-difference quotient remains 1 mod4, so doubling iteration gives ν2(f^(2^j)(x)-x)=3r+j, and the least period is 2^max(k-3r,0). Every valuation stratum size 2^(k-r-1) therefore has the claimed quotient count of cycles and zero is fixed. Odd a in one class mod8 satisfies ν2(f(a)-f(b))=ν2(a-b)+2, and odd residues map precisely to even targets ±2 mod32 with four sources per contributing source class and eight total. The resulting indegrees are 0:2^(k-1), 1:7*2^(k-4), 9:2^(k-4), with odd leaves depth exactly one. Independent brute force graphs k=5..11 matched complete cycle and indegree counts.
